method: Six complete hardware records only. Error=target-measured; original EMA .3; all 1501 points; no trimming, smoothing, shifts or baseline refitting.
primary_score: For each run, equal-weight mean MAE across the three predeclared 2 s plateau windows; then equal-weight mean across the two runs of each Ki.

selection_rule.tie_rule: Engineering tie threshold, not statistical significance: favor smaller Ki if plateau score differs by <=2 uT and return/full-path metrics are comparable.
selection_rule.guardrails: Compare individual records and worst run; do not accept lower plateau MAE with systematic degradation of 19..27 s return recovery, severe deviations or actuator behavior.
selection_rule.scope: Best candidate within 0.025/0.05/0.1 under the existing cap and dynamics; not an unconstrained/global optimum.

decision: Ki=.1 has lowest plateau score and full-path error; Ki=.05 has lower mean return-recovery error. Preserve .05 as comparison; .1 is a provisional candidate, not a final selection under the predeclared conflicting-metric rule.
